summary: The bridge is no longer one vague problem. Its logical implication is proved conditionally; four supporting gaps are closed; one state-size gap was exposed; the remaining P-vs-NP core is split into universal Lemma A (#211) and Lemma B (#212). Work now attacks #211 directly.

closed_components.name: POLICY0A_CORRECTNESS
closed_components.statement: Uncapped Policy-0A is a sound and complete SAT decision procedure.

closed_components.name: POLYNOMIAL_BRANCH_DEPTH
closed_components.statement: Maximum branching depth is at most the number of input variables and therefore polynomial in encoded input length.

closed_components.name: LOCAL_INFERENCE_BUDGET
closed_components.statement: The frozen one-layer Resolution work is polynomial in the current state representation size.

closed_components.name: CONDITIONAL_BRIDGE_THEOREM
closed_components.statement: If unique residual count, residual representation size, and deterministic primitive costs are polynomial in original input length, then Policy-0A decides CNF-SAT in polynomial time, hence P=NP.

newly_exposed_gap.reason: Polynomial state count alone does not imply polynomial total work because local resolvents may accumulate in individual residual representations.
newly_exposed_gap.claim_ceiling: This envelope shows the missing invariant; it is not a lower bound and does not prove exponential growth.

remaining_core.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_COUNT
remaining_core.target: Find fixed c such that S(F) <= N^c for every CNF F of encoded length N, or refute by an explicit infinite family with a rigorous superpolynomial lower bound for exact Policy-0A.

remaining_core.name: UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_SIZE
remaining_core.target: Find fixed a such that every residual encountered from every CNF F of encoded length N has bit_length <= N^a, or refute by an explicit infinite family.

topa_modification.policy: TOPA is not disabled. It is an active mathematical scout and adversary that may generate conjectures, invariants, counterfamilies, reductions, proof sketches and formal derivations.
topa_modification.promotion_law: Authority comes from a checkable derivation or counterexample, not from TOPA identity. A failed attack does not prove the rival claim.

issue_211_attack_run_0.finding: The repository finite graph-tautology probe is not literally the GT_n encoding used in the Beame-Impagliazzo-Pitassi-Segerlind Formula-Caching lower-bound theorem.

source_theorem_object.lower_bound: Theorem 4.6 gives exponentially many nodes for FCWSR on the original GT_n family.

repository_proxy_object.identity: lt(j,i) is represented as the negation of the same pair variable
repository_proxy_object.effect: antisymmetry/totality structure is compiled into the variable representation rather than represented by the original directed-variable clauses

issue_211_attack_run_0.consequence: The historical lower bound cannot be transferred directly to the current smart GT proxy. This is an additional theorem-transfer obligation, separate from local-Resolution robustness.

next_action: Attack #211 through A0 first: use the theorem-matched original GT_n encoding or prove a formal reduction from it to the repository proxy; do not import the historical lower bound before this gate passes.
